description: Receipt with conditional 'if shortlisted we'll arrange an interview' and 'if unsuccessful'

input.subject: Application received: Content Producer
input.text:
Hi Sam,

Thanks for applying for the Content Producer role at Larkspur Media.

If you are shortlisted, we will contact you to arrange an interview. If you have not heard from us within three weeks, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

Cheers,
Larkspur Media
